summary: Adds the compaction hint constant "from-selected-series". It is used by SetSelectedSeries/FromSelectedSeries, the planner's class segregation, hint propagation in CompactBlockMetas and Write, and the inOrderBlocksMaxTime exclusion. The string is persisted in block meta.json, so its value becomes an on-disk format that older readers and downstream tools such as Mimir will see.
headline: New persisted compaction hint constant for selected-series blocks
reason: The constant's value is written to block meta.json and drives planning and WAL-replay cutoff decisions, so it is a persisted format a reviewer must judge.
risk_signals: new compaction hint value affects planner and WAL-replay cutoff
focus: Hint string "from-selected-series" is the intended persisted value, since it is written to meta.json and is hard to rename later
Older Prometheus versions or tools reading blocks with this unknown hint treat them like regular blocks and may merge them or advance the WAL-replay cutoff
